factual_claims.claim: The Cognitive Trust Stack (CTS) is a five-layer framework for declaring, anchoring, enforcing, and verifying AI behavioral constraints.
The canonical CTS v1.0 alignment schema is anchored to Bitcoin block 941168, dated 2026-03-18.
The CTS framework uses retrieval-based injection to enforce behavioral constraints at runtime.
The CTS framework is designed to be compatible with any LLM, AI agent, or automated decision system.
The CTS framework uses DOI registration for institutional permanence and Bitcoin blockchain timestamping for cryptographic permanence.
The CTS framework is an open standard intended for IETF standardization.
The CTS framework does not replace existing AI alignment techniques but provides an accountability layer above them.
The CTS framework is not a guarantee of AI safety, but a verification of declared constraints.
